verdict.rationale: Okta offers a free Integrator plan explicitly meant to 'test your code and apps' (okta-docs-11/13), which implies a separate non-production org. It also has a free, open XAA playground with no setup or infrastructure required (okta-docs-6/12), but that playground covers only Cross App Access flows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that test orgs are isolated from production data, a general-purpose sandbox or preview environment for agent/MCP workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration.
